# csplit

Published version: `cli/csplit@0.2.6`. See the release inventory;
[latest.json](../../tests/release/latest.json) records the uploaded coordinates.

Split files at line or pattern boundaries for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/csplit@0.2.6 [OPTION]... FILE PATTERN...
```

## Supported scope

Split a file or stdin (`-`) using line numbers, `/BRE/[OFFSET]`, `%BRE%[OFFSET]`, `{N}` and `{*}`. Print fragment sizes by default.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-f` / `--prefix` | required | Use PREFIX instead of xx. Default: `xx`. |
| `-n` / `--digits` | required | Use at least NUMBER suffix digits (default 2). Default: `2`. |
| `-b` / `--suffix-format` | required | Use one d/i/u/o/x/X conversion for suffixes. |
| `--suppress-matched` | none | Omit the offset-adjusted split boundary line. |
| `-s` / `--silent` | none | Suppress output byte counts. |
| `-q` / `--quiet` | none | Same as --silent. |
| `-k` / `--keep-files` | none | Keep created fragments after a split error. |
| `-z` / `--elide-empty-files` | none | Omit empty output fragments. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Argument and exit-status contract

Ordinary option/operand errors exit 1; documented capability refusals retain their own status.

See the [finite diagnostic profile](../../docs/compatibility.md#extensions-and-diagnostics).

## Limitations

- Existing output paths are rejected. Windows names ending in spaces or dots are rejected.
- Requires temporary storage for the complete input and line index. Locale-specific matching is unsupported.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/csplit@0.2.6 input.txt 10
moonx cli/csplit@0.2.6 -f part- input.txt '/^SECTION/' '{*}'
```
